c-member-link-preview.1.expected: the published topic shows a card with title, image and site name.
c-member-link-preview.1.actual: bob published a topic whose body is only https://wordpress.org/news/ (a standalone link): the topic shows just a quote box with the link 'News' - no title, image or site name - because the URL goes through the WordPress oEmbed (blockquote + hidden iframe) and the browser logs 'Refused to display https://wordpress.org/ in a frame because X-Frame-Options is sameorigin'. A standalone github.com link in the same composer did give a proper card (GitHub badge, image, title, description). An inline link inside a sentence gets no card (only a standalone link does)

c-member-link-preview.3.evidence: standalone YouTube URL -> iframe player (Me at the zoo); standalone x.com/jack/status/20 -> twitter provider embed (tweet iframe); both render under their link

c-member-link-preview.4.evidence: guest on the github.com topic: the same card (GitHub, image, title, description) renders

c-member-link-preview.5.evidence: localhost, 127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, 10.0.0.5 and file:///etc/passwd -> each 200 with identical empty previews (no title/description/image/embed), per the owner's decision (no 400)

c-member-link-preview.6.evidence: 127.0.0.1.nip.io, localtest.me and a public URL redirecting to 127.0.0.1 -> 200 empty preview, nothing fetched (owner decision: no 400 message)

c-member-link-preview.7.evidence: a URL whose server hangs 30s: /link-preview gave up at 6.08s with an empty preview; a topic containing it published in 55 ms as a plain link

c-member-link-preview.8.evidence: https://httpbin.org/status/503 -> 200 empty (no PHP error); the retry came back in 31 ms (first 1017 ms), i.e. the short negative cache

c-member-link-preview.9.evidence: the same good URL three times: 61 ms, 31 ms, 26 ms with identical data (cached)

c-member-link-preview.10.evidence: redirect chain of 6 hops and a 1000-hop redirect -> 200 empty (owner decision: no 400); chain of 6 took 6.7 s, so the follow is capped

c-member-link-preview.11.evidence: guest GET /link-preview for http://127.0.0.1/ -> 200 empty preview, no fetch. Security note: a guest also gets full previews for public URLs (wordpress.org returned title and image without login), so the endpoint is an anonymous server-side fetch

c-member-link-preview.12.evidence: 146-character unbroken URL in a topic: the link wraps over 4 lines inside the column (x199-928) and the card stays x199-759; no horizontal scroll

c-member-link-preview.13.evidence: card at 390: x48-342, 346px tall, image scaled to 292x146, no horizontal scroll

c-member-link-preview.14.evidence: dark mode on Reign: card background srgb(.18,.19,.23) on page rgb(35,38,47), title rgb(229,229,229), description light grey, border white 12%

c-member-link-preview.15.expected: the card title renders right to left.
c-member-link-preview.15.actual: link to an Arabic page (aljazeera.net): the card title 'الجزيرة نت' and its Arabic description are laid out left-to-right and left-aligned (title has direction ltr, no dir=auto), with the Arabic comma at the start of lines; it does not render right to left

proposed_checks: - `c-member-link-preview.16` @guest #rest: GET /link-preview for a public URL logged out -> either 401 or a rate-limited answer (today it is an open server-side fetch).

- `c-member-link-preview.17` @member #ui: a standalone wordpress.org post link shows a card with title, image and site name (today only a quote box with the link because the oEmbed iframe is blocked).
notes: Used github.com, youtube.com, x.com, aljazeera.net and httpbin.org as outside URLs; topics deleted afterwards.
